method_authority.association_rule: For every pair of source views, connect reciprocal-best proposal pairs whose soft membership cosine is at least 0.5. Consume edges strongest-first while requiring disjoint source-view sets, so a track contains at most one proposal observation per view.
method_authority.threshold_authority: 0.5 is the preregistered majority-overlap identity boundary inherited from exact-MPR membership; it was not selected using ScanNet labels or metrics.
method_authority.singleton_policy: A proposal without independent source-view confirmation remains untracked and cannot drive object voting.
method_authority.track_membership: clipped sum/union of source proposal memberships
method_authority.typed_readout: primitive RADIO logits plus bounded thing-only object-track vote; wall/floor/ceiling and low-confidence rows retain primitive fallback
method_authority.future_object_affinity_compatibility: The typed voter consumes only sparse Gaussian-track membership, so a learned compact object-affinity head can replace this analytic bridge without changing category logic.

assets.camera_asset_audit: Raw dataset camera/RGB roots referenced by historical configs are not mounted at dataset/scannet_og on this host. This does not block the bridge because each completed exact-MPR membership bundle is already camera/geometry registered and stores source view IDs. Reprojection or new mask extraction would require remounting the raw dataset.

pilot_result.reason: All seven-scene confirmation macro metrics are positive, but the frozen rule fails the per-scene split10 no-regression safety gate.

shortest_full8_bridge.execution: The remaining four raw score banks were materialized and the unchanged CPU track compiler/voter was evaluated on all paper8 scenes.

decision: Stop the analytic track-voting branch without post-metric class-count fallback or threshold retuning. Retain it only as the typed interface test and evidence for a learned source-only compact object-affinity head.
